login.title: Sign in
login.description: Use the email connected to your academy account.

forgot.title: Reset your password
forgot.description: Enter your email and we will send recovery instructions if it belongs to an active account.

reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.description: Set a new password for the account that opened the recovery link.
reset.passwordHint: Use at least 8 characters and avoid easy-to-guess words.

mfa.title: Protect administration with an authenticator app
mfa.description: A time-based code is required before any administration page or action can open.
mfa.principle: Your password remains the first factor. The rotating code proves that the approved authenticator is also with you.
mfa.enrollDescription: Start setup, then scan the QR code with an authenticator app such as Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator, or 1Password.
mfa.qrAlt: QR code for adding Noor Al-Wahy Academy to an authenticator app
mfa.manualCode: Cannot scan? Enter this setup key manually
mfa.verifyDescription: Enter the current six-digit code from your authenticator app.
mfa.error: The code or setup could not be verified. Check the current code and try again.
mfa.recovery: Lost access to your authenticator? Sign out and ask the authorized system owner to reset the factor after verifying your identity.
mfa.signOut: Sign out and return to login

status.resetSent: If the email belongs to an account, recovery instructions will arrive shortly. Check the junk folder too.
